messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeout spike on /v1/stream across us-west-2. p95 ~ 1.2s (threshold 600ms), p99 ~ 3.6s. 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% → 8%. Trigger: deploy abc123 @ 2026-03-15T10:00:00Z. Pager: sam (oncall)

sam (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up traces & logs. @maya @leo please standby.

sam (oncall): quick curl to gateway shows intermittent 504s and long TTFB:
```
$ curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connection timed out after 3000ms
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```

maya (eng-runtime): looking at host metrics — the model-pool in us-west-2 shows elevated KV cache evictions at T+2m post-deploy, memory pressure on host-12 and host-14. Multiplex queue length spiked. Might be a memory/packing regress from the new runtime path.

leo (sre): Gateway traces show backend connections queuing on keepalive exhaustion. p99 connection wait time ~ 900ms. Also seeing increased grpc-errors upstream (code 14).

sam (oncall): Customer impact estimate: ~12% of chat requests seeing errors or >5s. Not full outage but severe tail. Notifying SRE, Support. Maria please inform CS/ops with a short blurb.

maria (support): pinged CS channels and one large customer (Remora) reported timeouts. Escalating to account team. Will update support ticket.

maya (eng-runtime): hypothesis: new kernel selector + quantized path changed memory layout; causes cache thrash under certain sequence-length distribution. Can reproduce locally with traffic-mix script.

leo (sre): mitigation options: 1) scale up gateway pool 2) disable new runtime flag 3) rollback release. Can we do a fast rollback? ops-bot, can you verify rollback readiness?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback available. Previous stable is def456. Rolling back release abc123 -> def456 in us-west-2 (canary and prod) upon confirmation. ETA ~ 60-120s.

sam (oncall): proceed with rollback to def456 for us-west-2 now. Marking incident as P1.

ops-bot: exec: deploy rollback --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --from=abc123 --to=def456
ops-bot: initiated rollback. Streaming events...

sam (oncall): while rollback runs, apply short-term throttle: decrease gateway max_concurrency to 80% and temporarily increase request timeout to 45s for streaming to avoid immediate 5xx storms.

maya (eng-runtime): issuing commands to adjust gateway config:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment gateway --replicas=12
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/gateway MAX_CONCURRENCY=160
```

leo (sre): also bumping keepalive pool size on proxy layer to reduce connection churn.

ops-bot: rollback progress: canary reverted (us-west-2-canary), 3/4 prod shards rolled back, final shard in progress.

(2m later)

ops-bot: rollback complete: release def456 is active in us-west-2. health checks passing.

incident-bot: NOTE: post-rollback telemetry scan shows p99 dropped to ~420ms, p95 ~220ms, 5xx back to baseline 0.3%.

sam (oncall): confirmed via dashboards. Thank you. Immediate customer impact largely mitigated. Maria, please update customer comms with apology and ETA for full root-cause follow-up.

maria (support): wrote update to affected customers. tagging ops for any credits.

maya (eng-runtime): capturing repro inputs and a minimized test. Will open a bug linking traces, heap profiles, and the offending commit. Suspect area: kernel selector + kvcache eviction interaction during batching.

leo (sre): taking incident ownership for postmortem. Tasks: collect flamegraphs, RPC traces, deployment diffs, and rollout timing. CC: sam, maya. Handing off oncall.

sam (oncall): handing off to leo for postmortem. I'm clear. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

leo (sre): acknowledged. Opening postmortem ticket INC-2026-043. Please drop any screenshots/logs into that doc.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation) — followup: postmortem due in 72h.

(End of thread)
